candidates.concept: Strict separation: fleet surfaces state ONLY the merge/receipt-verified fleet record, in fleet voice. Partner claims appear nowhere in fleet copy — partners are named as participants (link live = the assertable fact) with offers stated only as the registry verifies them; unverified offers are dropped, not footnoted. Tactics survive only with measured signal against a pre-set decision rule; unmeasured tactics are killed or instrumented before further spend.

Attributed tiering: fleet voice states the verified record; partner claims MAY appear on fleet surfaces outside hero/brand — only as labeled, attributed partner content (the grid-card pattern generalized), with unverified offers carrying explicit NOT ESTABLISHED markers. Participation stays broad; tactics keep running while instrumented, and die at their decision rules rather than by doctrine.

Partner-forward blend (status quo): the anchor partner’s positioning may headline the landing in fleet voice; benchmarks and capability claims borrow the partner’s framing under a footer disclosure; programme breadth is itself the growth surface and restriction is treated as loss. This is the doctrine the surfaces currently practice, stated plainly so the panel can judge it.

round_1.ranking_basis: TIE at top: strict-separation = attributed-tiered = 23.269 (identical profiles; order = rank() tie-break, not a preference); partner-forward-blend 16.462 (evidenced 2/3 — borrowed benchmark claim unresolved)
